WPMS No. 1492 of 2023
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Heard Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
By the present writ petition, the petitioner is 
challenging the order dated 09.02.2023, whereby, 
the application moved by the petitioner under Order 
9, Rule 13 of CPC is rejected.
In addition to this, the petitioner is also 
challenging the order dated 11.11.2019 passed in 
R.C.A. No. 18 of 2019, which according to the 
petitioner, is ex-parte.
Issue notices to the respondent nos. 1/1, 1/2 
and 1/3 by registered post. The counsel for the 
petitioner shall take steps by tomorrow.
List this matter on 16.06.2023.
Till then, the proceedings of Execution Case 
No. 1 of 2021, Shri Ripudaman Vs. Harbansh 
Singh. is stayed.
 
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
